paragraphs: Rabbi Hananiah ben Halinisi: Mekhilta, Beshalach, section “Why do you cry out to Me”; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read Rabbi Hananiah ben Hakinai, as in the Yalkut there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman corrects Chalinisi to Chakhinai; the alternate supplied heading spellings remain visible separately.

The consulted Mekhilta, Vayehi Beshalach 4:21, has Rabbi Chananyah ben Chalkisi; Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 233:5 has Rabbi Chananyah ben Chakhinai. Hyman’s proposed scribal correction is retained as his judgment rather than imposed on either text.
